subject.title: Brea Olinda Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: Appointed Governing Board Member, Brea Olinda Unified School District, Area 4

As the current Trustee for Brea Olinda Unified School District Area 4, appointed by the Board of Education to fill the Area 4 vacancy, it has been an honor to serve the students, families, educators, and community of Brea. As both a parent of two children attending BOUSD schools and an educational leader with more than a decade of experience, I bring the perspective of someone who understands the importance of strong public schools from both the family and professional viewpoints.

Since joining the Board of Education, I have been committed to thoughtful, transparent decision-making, supporting student achievement, and working collaboratively with fellow trustees, district leadership, staff, families, and the community. I remain focused on maintaining safe and welcoming schools, supporting our dedicated educators, ensuring responsible stewardship of district resources, and providing every student with the opportunity to succeed.
I respectfully ask for your support so I can continue serving Trustee Area 4 with integrity, collaboration, and a strong commitment to excellence for all students.

text: My name is Wendy Criner, and I am running for Brea Olinda School Board, Area 4. My entire career has been centered on supporting our youth–in the classroom as a public school teacher, on the pool deck and the field as a coach, and at the decision-making table on the School Site Council. With your support, I’m ready to bring that experience to the school board.

My husband and I moved to Brea over 15 years ago for its exceptional schools. Our two daughters attended Falcon Academy, Brea Junior High, and Brea Olinda High School. I believe in practical, thoughtful solutions that support student growth and foster critical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and global readiness.

As a district, we must address complex challenges responsibly. As we move forward with Measure H projects, it is vital that funds are invested with fiscal prudence to ensure safe, healthy, and supportive learning environments for all students.

Our schools are the heart of Brea. Our community deserves a leader who understands both the classroom and local values. I am committed to protecting our investments, empowering teachers, and putting children first. I respectfully ask for your vote.
